text:
Aisha (CS): Hey team — quick weekly SummitAI health sync. Main highlights: usage steady, spend +5% QoQ, but p99 spike on /chat non-stream yesterday. Posting p95/p99 by route+model + streaming vs non-streaming.

Devon (SE): thanks — can you drop the per-route numbers? Curious about streaming perf delta for chat.

Aisha (CS): Sure. Numbers below are rolling 7d, 95th/99th percentiles in ms, error rate and sample size.

```
route       model     mode         p95(ms) p99(ms) err%  requests/day
/chat       t5-xl     streaming    310     920    0.3%  18k
/chat       t5-xl     non-stream   480     1450   1.1%  2.5k
/completion gpt-mini  sync         670     1800   2.0%  4k
/embed      tiny      streaming     45     120    0.02% 60k
/rerank     llama2    non-stream   1250    3400   3.5%  800
```

Fernando (SRE): Noted the rerank p99. Any known pattern — tail due to long inputs or retries?

Aisha (CS): Rerank errors concentrated on long batch jobs (>10k tokens) + occasional OOMs on dedicated pool. We've limited batch size to 512 for this customer last night.

Ivy (Customer): We saw a timeout at 14:32 UTC yesterday that caused a retry in our flow. Impacted only 3/200 requests but added latency.

Devon (SE): For /chat, streaming looks ~35-45% faster p95 and much better p99. Recommend default enable streaming for chat routes. Also propose prefix caching for repeated instructions.

Aisha (CS): Action items:
- Devon: pull logs for /rerank OOMs and share by Tue (@Devon) :card_file_box:
- Fernando: increase retry-backoff and raise memory limit on dedicated pool to 96GB for SummitAI by EOD tomorrow.
- Aisha: Send updated onboarding doc and cost estimate to Ivy.

OncallBot: Incident created: INC-2026-9414 — rerank OOMs — assigned Fernando.

Devon (SE): Quick snippet for customers to prefer streaming:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
 -d '{"route":"/chat","model":"t5-xl","stream":true}'
```

Ivy (Customer): Thanks — will enable streaming on our staging tomorrow and report back.

Aisha (CS): Closing note: spend trend +5% mostly from embed volume; recommend budget cap for embed route. Next sync Thursday 10am PST. :calendar:
